# Repository SEO And AI Overview Setup

Use this checklist to strengthen the canonical GitHub repository URL:

https://github.com/aiapplications001-art/seo-page-creator-agent

## GitHub About Description

Recommended repository description:

```text
SEO Page Creator Agent - AI SEO content generator that turns a website URL into SEO content and a local HTML preview.
```

## GitHub Website Field

Recommended URL:

```text
https://www.npmjs.com/package/seo-page-creator-agent
```

Alternative if a docs/demo page is created later:

```text
https://github.com/aiapplications001-art/seo-page-creator-agent
```

## GitHub Topics

Use 10-15 highly relevant topics:

```text
seo
seo-tools
seo-automation
ai-agent
content-generation
content-optimization
programmatic-seo
serp-analysis
keyword-research
content-marketing
typescript
cli
google-search-console
generative-ai
content-workflow
```

## Social Preview

Upload a social preview image in GitHub:

Repository -> Settings -> Social preview -> Edit -> Upload an image

Recommended visual text:

```text
SEO Page Creator Agent
Website URL -> SEO Content + Local HTML Preview
github.com/aiapplications001-art/seo-page-creator-agent
```

Use `.github/marketing/social-preview.svg` as the source artwork and export it to PNG before uploading if GitHub does not accept SVG.

## GitHub Release

Create a GitHub Release:

```text
Tag: v0.1.0
Title: v0.1.0 - Initial public release of SEO Page Creator Agent
```

Use `docs/releases/v0.1.0.md` as the release body.

## External Mentions

When linking from npm, docs, articles, social posts, and profile READMEs, use the full canonical URL:

```text
https://github.com/aiapplications001-art/seo-page-creator-agent
```

Recommended anchor text:

- SEO Page Creator Agent
- AI SEO content generator
- SEO page creator agent
- seo-page-creator-agent
